csv_project_name: Pavement Management Plan Update ADA & Sidewalk
csv_scope_of_work: City of Glendale ( City ) Department of Public Works is requesting proposals to (1) update the City s Pavement Management Plan (PMP) using a defensible, repeatable, and traceable methodology; (2) produce a prioritized 5-year CIP and 10-year funding scenarios that optimize return on investment (ROI) and clearly communicate consequences of deferred maintenance; and (3) deliver implementable tools and datasets (MicroPAVER, ArcGIS Pro GIS database, and a hosted public-facing PCI web map) to support ongoing program administration. The selected consultant shall provide services including updating the pavement management plan, performing sidewalk and ADA condition assessments, developing related policies, and conducting future program re-assessments.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Inspection Services, Materials Testing, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
